title: 6 new things in your app!
intro: You picked them in the poll, so here they are. Tap 👀 Show me how for the steps, or ▶ Try it to jump straight in.

items.pitch: A silly or tricky dance dare every day.
steps: Find the 🎯 dare card near the top of Today.
Read today's dare and do it! 💃
Tap “I did it! 🎉”. That's your practice for the day, plus ⭐ 1 star.
Not feeling it? Tap “🎲 Try another” once a day for a new one.

items.pitch: Collect a card for every trick you land.
steps: Open Me and tap “🃏 Open my binder”.
In Skills on Me, tap a trick until it says ◉ Clean. Now it's your card!
When your teacher checks it, it turns ✨ shiny!
Tap a card you earned, then 📷 “Add a photo” of you doing the trick.

items.pitch: Design your dream show costume on your dancer.
steps: On Me, tap “✨ Design a costume”.
Pick a leotard colour, skirt, sleeves, sparkle and a headpiece.
Give it a name and tap “✅ Keep design” (you can keep 6), or “👗 Wear it”.
Tap “💾 Save picture” to share your design.

items.pitch: One photo a month, then flip through and see how you've grown.
steps: On Me, find the 🌱 Glow-Up Flipbook card and pick your pose.
Tap “📷 This month's photo”. A grown-up can take it for you.
Every month, take it again in the same pose.
Tap “▶ Flip” to watch yourself grow, or “🪞 First vs now”.

items.pitch: Be the teacher! Make an 8-count and teach it.
steps: On Play, tap 🎓 Teach It.
Fill the 8 counts with moves, one move on each count.
Tap “🎓 Teach it”. Your dancer shows it slow, then at full speed.
Your friend or a grown-up tries it, then you give 1–3 stars and a tip!

items.pitch: Tap the beat and see if you're right on the counts.
steps: On Play, tap 🥁 Count Along.
Pick your dance music with “▶ Find the beat”, or practise with the metronome.
Tap the big pad on every beat.
Perfect taps make a streak. See how on the beat you were!
